products.name: Standard Basilisk Antidote (Unstabilised)
products.description: Cures Basilisk and Gorgon petrification. WARNING: Chalk-stone buffer is vulnerable to Sulphur Fog (-55% potency in sulphur-rich rooms).
reactionNotes: SULPHUR VULNERABILITY: Degrades if deployed inside Sulphur Fog without Calcified Quartz or Chelating Stabiliser.

products.name: Quartz-Chelated Basilisk Antidote
products.description: Stabilised with Calcified Quartz Salt and Wax Micro-Capsules. Retains full anti-petrification efficacy even inside dense Sulphur Fog.
reactionNotes: SULPHUR IMMUNE: Chelating Quartz prevents sulphuric degradation.

products.name: Bantam Chicken-Morph Draught
products.description: Shrinks the drinker into a nimble 15kg bantam rooster (-65kg mass). Easily walks across 35kg–70kg pressure plates without triggering them, though direct combat power drops.
reactionNotes: Reduces Hero Mass by 65kg (Bypasses Pressure Plates >= 25kg)
Side Effect: -25% direct monster melee damage while transformed.

products.name: Charcoal Alchemical Breather Tonic
products.description: Neutralises choking Sulphur Fog and restores scout perception inside gas-filled dungeon rooms.
reactionNotes: Prevents Sulphur Fog from blinding scouts or spoiling secondary potions.

products.name: Rust-Monster Gear Solvent Bomb
products.description: Shatter-ampoule packed with Rust-Monster Antenna Powder. Rapidly oxidises iron pressure plates and clockwork springs.
reactionNotes: Sabotages mechanical traps unless protected by Sacrificial Zinc Anode.

products.name: 45kg Pressure-Plate Spike Battery
products.description: Reliable dungeon staple. Triggers when any hero weighing >= 45kg steps on the cobble slab. Vulnerable to Chicken-Morph mass bypass.
reactionNotes: Counterplay: Mass Bypass (<45kg), Scout Detection (DC 42), or Rust Sabotage.

products.name: Pneumatic Sulphur-Fog Machine
products.description: Floods the dungeon chamber with thick yellow sulphur vapour. Obscures Basilisks (+25 DC) and chemically degrades unstabilised Basilisk Antidotes!
reactionNotes: SYNERGY: Weakens Unstabilised Basilisk Antidote by 55% unless heroes wear Charcoal Breathers!

products.name: Armored Cave-Basilisk Lair Module
products.description: Releases a hungry Cave Basilisk whose gaze petrifies heroes lacking a working Basilisk Antidote. Pairs wickedly with a Sulphur-Fog Machine.
reactionNotes: Inflicts Petrification unless countered by active Basilisk Antidote.
Creates massive Hero demand for Antidotes after every raid!

products.name: 8kg Quartz-Wire Vitriol Sprayer
products.description: Designed specifically for Dungeon Masters tired of Chicken-Morphing heroes. 8kg quartz tripwire catches even bantam roosters!

masters.name: Skritch the Under-Bailiff
masters.title: Self-Appointed Tollkeeper of Cistern Four
masters.personality: Frugal, jumpy, obsessed with keeping shiny brass trinkets out of hero hands.
memoryLog: Day 1: Opened trade ledger with your shop. Needs cheap pressure-plate traps.
Day 1 After-Action: Skritch the Under-Bailiff furious that 45kg plates were bypassed by lightweight heroes; now demands <10kg Hair-Trigger Quartz traps!
Day 4 After-Action: Skritch the Under-Bailiff wants higher Concealment DC modules so scouts stop spotting traps.
masters.desiredTrait: Skritch the Under-Bailiff demands higher Concealment DC upgrades

masters.name: Matron Brine-Bog
masters.title: Proprietor of the Sunken Mushroom Grotto
masters.personality: Chatty swamp-witch who views dungeon raids as ticketed tourist attractions.
memoryLog: Day 1: Wants non-lethal or poison hazards that scare heroes into dropping gear without killing all future customers.
Day 2 After-Action: Matron Brine-Bog furious that 45kg plates were bypassed by lightweight heroes; now demands <10kg Hair-Trigger Quartz traps!
masters.desiredTrait: Matron Brine-Bog demands <10kg Hair-Trigger Traps to counter Bantam Chicken-Morph Draught

Day 3 After-Action: Alderman Vance (Disgraced) furious that 45kg plates were bypassed by lightweight heroes; now demands <10kg Hair-Trigger Quartz traps!

masters.name: Duchess Sallowgold
masters.title: Matriarch of the Glittering Maze
masters.personality: Flamboyant collector who streams dungeon spectacles to high-society patrons.
memoryLog: Day 1: Pays premium margins for high-prestige, visually dramatic traps.

masters.title: Grand Magus of the Blackspire Panopticon

intelFeed.headline: Skritch the Under-Bailiff Relies on 45kg Flagstone Pressure Plates

intelFeed.headline: Rumour: Vane & Sons Dumping Cheap Breathable Masks Next Turn
intelFeed.detail: A warehouse clerk claims Vane & Sons Alchemicals has crated 40 units of bargain Charcoal Breathers to undercut your countermeasure sales if the Silver Stag raid goes poorly.

intelFeed.headline: Paradox Catalyst Commission Protocol Active
intelFeed.detail: Gold cannot buy entry to The Paradox Vault. Complete Vespera’s 3-Stage Bilateral Commission (supplying both high-lethality traps and sulphur-immune chelated tonics across campaigns) OR receive a verified Offline Peer Catalyst Transfer in the Archives.
